question: On the credential-free GET-only stdlib-HTTP substrate, can site-native discovery channels (robots-sitemap, sitemap.xml, on-site search index, RSS/Atom, JSON-LD) expose intentionally deep (hop>=3) state-carrying pages within K=3 GETs, at per-host rate >=0.50, on >=2 hosts spanning >=2 doc-site engines, when the frame is a fresh 4-site pool frozen at DESIGN time?
hypothesis: Site-native discovery channels provide shallow (O(K), K=3) GET accounting to pages that a naive same-host StaticLinks crawl only reaches at hop>=3, so deep content is not intrinsically path-bound: per-host reachability fraction >=0.50 with discovery channels on at least 2 hosts spanning at least 2 engines (mdBook, Sphinx).

falsifier.description: Arithmetically checkable before freeze (admission gate + branch-drive over the exact frozen code) and satisfiable in both directions on the frozen pool: SUPPORTS and FALSIFIES and MIXED and INCONCLUSIVE and MEASUREMENT_INVALID are all reachable in the branch-drive executable scenarios (all_branches_reachable=true on 8 scenario branches).
falsifier.positive_branch: E >= 2 hosts with discovery_reachable_fraction >= 0.50 AND the meeting hosts span >= 2 engines -> SUPPORTS
falsifier.negative_branch: E = 0 hosts with fraction >= 0.50 -> FALSIFIES; otherwise MIXED (E == 1, or all meeting hosts belong to a single engine)
falsifier.per_channel_disclosure: Mandatory: report per-channel and per-host fractions, per-hop cost trend (3..6), and all baseline deltas. These secondary numbers are descriptive, never decisional.

B_LINK_FOLLOWING_BFS.description: Same-host link-following BFS shortest-path hop from EXP-FRONTIER-37950626378: cost = hop+1 GETs replayed per admitted DEEP item.
B_LINK_FOLLOWING_BFS.metric: hop_depth and GETs per admitted DEEP item (replayed after the measurement phase)

B_PERSISTED_PATH_REACQUISITION.description: Persisted-path re-acquisition (RACQ_PATH) from EXP-FRONTIER-37950626378: replay the frozen discovery path as absolute GETs.
B_PERSISTED_PATH_REACQUISITION.metric: RACQ_PATH.requests and .bytes per admitted DEEP item

B_DIRECT_URL_REPLAY.description: Direct URL replay (RACQ_URL) from EXP-FRONTIER-37950626378: 1 GET on the item URL.
B_DIRECT_URL_REPLAY.metric: RACQ_URL.requests (=1) and .bytes per admitted DEEP item

B_NO_DISCOVERY.description: Algebraic floor: 0.0 reachable fraction — instantiated by CAL_OPAQUE_FIXTURE (0/5 on all channels).

U_NO_BOUND.description: Algebraic ceiling: 1.0 reachable fraction — instantiated by CAL_DISCOVERABLE_FIXTURE (5/5 on all channels).

positive_control.description: The discovery-channel machinery itself is live and sensitive on real, non-pool web hosts and on bracketed local fixtures.
positive_control.pass_criterion: All three arms observed live at DESIGN (recorded in prereg.md section 13 probe log): (a) out-of-pool liveness hosts (github.blog, www.gnu.org, www.php.net, wordpress.org, www.jetbrains.com) — >=2 hosts parse >=1 URL through the exact frozen channel resolvers; (b) CAL_DISCOVERABLE_FIXTURE: 5/5 items reachable on all 5 channels, CAL_OPAQUE_FIXTURE: 0/5 on all 5 channels -> CALIBRATION_GATE True; (c) PC_HOP_CONFIRMATION: each pool seed confirmed at hop 0 with hop==1 and hop>=3 pages found (samples recorded in target_pool).
positive_control.evidence_required: HTTP status, content-type, parsed entry counts per channel per host; fixture per-channel reachability matrix; hop samples per host.

null_control.description: Two synthetic item identifiers (spider-nonexistent-38085197666-a.html / -b.html) appended to each probe host's origin; such items cannot exist in any sitemap, search index, feed or JSON-LD assembled from the live frames.
null_control.pass_criterion: null_all_zero = true: 0 reachable across every (probe host x channel) combination at DESIGN; at EXECUTE the same synthetic items are probed on the frozen pool hosts and any nonzero hit triggers MEASUREMENT_INVALID with distribution analysis.
null_control.purpose: Validates that discovery channels do not hallucinate/reflect synthetic items (false positives), and brackets hit-rate noise floor at 0.

measurement_validity.VN-V1_substrate: Credential-free GET-only stdlib-HTTP (urllib.request). No JS execution, no browser, no API keys, no cookies.
measurement_validity.VN-V2_frozen_pool: Target pool of 4 seed URLs frozen at DESIGN time (recorded in target_pool). The pool was screened for credential-free reachability and hop topology BEFORE finalization (exposure-blind: no pool-host discovery-surface probe drove selection; the only pool-host discovery fetches at DESIGN were 404 negatives during connectivity screening, disclosed in prereg section 15).
measurement_validity.VN-V3_discovery_channels: Five channels frozen at DESIGN: ROBOTS_SITEMAP (robots.txt Sitemap directive), SITEMAP_XML (sitemap.xml, nested index chains allowed but exceed K => K_EXCEEDED), ON_SITE_SEARCH (majority-language static search index searchindex.js: mdBook JSON.parse([...]) / Sphinx Search.setIndex({...})), RSS_ATOM (rss.xml then atom.xml), JSON_LD (JSON-LD blocks on the seed root page only, cold-start). Exact resolver semantics and endpoint lists in prereg sections 5 and 13.
measurement_validity.VN-V4_k_budget: K=3 logical GETs per item per channel: channel discovery GET(s) + item GET. Redirects make 1 logical GET. Budget exhaustion, index chains, 4xx/5xx, parser failures and timeouts are all counted as not-reachable (never silently skipped).
measurement_validity.VN-V5_hop_confirmation: Shortest-path hop for every DEEP item confirmed by the frozen same-host StaticLinks BFS (depth-6, budget 250, path-prefix constrained per seed). DEEP := hop>=3 and page carries >=1 named input/select/textarea (state-carrying proxy; degenerate-but-consistent: it is site chrome present on nearly every doc page, disclosed as a validity limitation).
measurement_validity.VN-V6_channel_independence: Each channel is probed independently and the item is counted reachable if ANY channel succeeds on that item (primary metric). Per-channel fractions are reported separately (descriptive).
measurement_validity.VN-V7_no_token_latency_cost: No tokenizer, latency-timer or dollar-cost modeling in the measurement. Cost is physical GET count and wall time only.
measurement_validity.VN-V8_static_parser_only: HTML parsing uses stdlib html.parser, xml.etree and re only. Link collection is StaticLinks (<a href>), index parsing is strict (regex + json), failures surface as parse failures, not as zeros swept under the rug.
measurement_validity.VN-V9_attainability_certificate: Pre-freeze control certificate recorded in pre_freeze_control_certificate with live evidence (pool gate, fixtures, out-of-pool channel liveness, null control, branch-drive, code hash). Deviation note vs the audit's literal VN-V9(b): channel liveness is demonstrated on out-of-pool hosts and local fixtures, NOT by probing frozen pool hosts at DESIGN — probing pool-host discovery surfaces pre-freeze would rupture exposure-blindness and could mask a genuine FALSIFIES (same rationale as the parent's FIX_FRAME_EXPOSING_LIVENESS_CONTROL). The pool-host channel reality IS the measurement.
measurement_validity.VN-V10_single_episode: Every item x channel probe is a fresh episode (no cross-item caching of channel documents). Fetch carry-over: a channel document fetched for item A is re-fetched fresh for item B; only the pool build crawl reuses its own seen-set (that crawl feeds hop/labels only, not reachability).
measurement_validity.VN-V11_ua_dependence: Design observation: www.sphinx-doc.org and docs.readthedocs.io return 403 to the default Python-urllib User-Agent but 200 to a Mozilla-compatible UA; the frozen protocol therefore pins UA to 'Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; spider-design-probe/1.0)'. UA dependence is a disclosed substrate property, not a treatment.
measurement_validity.VN-V12_live_content_drift: The web is live: DEEP counts per host drift between runs (google.github.io observed 213 via the screening probe tool and 168 via the frozen harness 40 minutes later; three consecutive frozen-harness runs were identical: 168/194/28/28). The admission gate (not exact counts) is the binding predicate and is re-verified at EXECUTE from a fresh crawl.

decision_rule.primary_metric: R_HOST_UNITS[h] = discovery_reachable_fraction[h] = count(DEEP items on host h reachable in <= K=3 GETs via ANY channel) / count(sampled DEEP items on host h). Sampling: deterministic URL-sort capped at 40 items/host (compr 40, rustc 40, sphinxdoc 28, pandas 28 => 136 episodes).
decision_rule.per_engine_metric: discovery_reachable_fraction_per_engine[e] = mean of R_HOST_UNITS over hosts of engine e (descriptive).

outcome_mapping.SUPPORTS: E >= 2 hosts with R_HOST_UNITS >= 0.50 AND meeting hosts span >= 2 engines
outcome_mapping.MIXED: E == 1, or all meeting hosts belong to exactly one engine
outcome_mapping.INCONCLUSIVE: empty candidate denominator (host crawl produced 0 DEEP items after exclusions)
outcome_mapping.MEASUREMENT_INVALID: admission gate fails at EXECUTE; calibration gate fails; exclusions exceed 10% on any host; synthetic null control hits on pool hosts; or embedded-code hash mismatch

decision_rule.admission_gate: ADMISSION_GATE_V2: frozen pool must have >=10 admitted DEEP items total, >=2 hosts with >=3 DEEP items each, and >=2 engines with >=3 DEEP items each. Verified live at DESIGN: total 418, hosts 4 (168/194/28/28), engines mdBook 362 / Sphinx 56. Re-verified at EXECUTE from a fresh crawl.
decision_rule.per_channel_reporting: Mandatory: report discovery_reachable_fraction_per_channel[host,channel] and per-host cost trend by hop; descriptive only.

product_consequence_positive: If reachability >=0.50 on >=2 hosts spanning >=2 engines at K=3, then hop depth is not an intrinsic acquisition barrier on doc-site frames: kernels may adopt channel-first discovery (sitemap/searchindex/feed/JSON-LD resolvers) as first-class GET hops, collapsing the depth-cost curve for deep doc content. This primes the C-CROSSSITE holdout: the same resolver set must then transfer to a held-out site (next_gate) without site-identity leakage.
product_consequence_negative: If reachability <0.50 on <2 engines at K=3, then on this frame discovery channels are not a general O(1) escape hatch: the cost curve stays hop-bound for deep pages, channel resolvers stay a per-host optional microfeature, and the C-CROSSSITE transfer hypothesis is not supported on the channel axis (bounded rejection of channel-transfer within this frame only).

estimated_cost.http_gets_estimate: ~1000-2500 GETs at EXECUTE: pool build ~933 GETs, 136 sampled items x 5 channels x 1-3 GETs in fresh episodes, controls and baseline replays. DESIGN already spent ~2500 GETs screening/verifying (topology-only, exposure-blind) - disclosed in prereg section 15.
estimated_cost.compute_cost: Negligible: stdlib HTTP + html.parser only; zero LLM calls inside measurement; single-threaded paced fetch (0.15s) to stay polite.
estimated_cost.external_dependencies: Live public web endpoints; urllib stdlib; no keys, no JS, no browser.

expected_information_gain: High and decision-relevant: discriminates 'deep pages are path-bound (hop is a real acquisition barrier)' vs 'deep pages are O(K) reachable via channels', the parent's central C-CROSSSITE-relevant cost-supremacy question for doc-site frames; every outcome changes the frontier kernel work list either toward channel-first resolvers (SUPPORTS/MIXED) or keeps link-following kernels with channels as per-host optionality (FALSIFIES).

pre_freeze_control_certificate.note: Deviation vs literal audit VN-V9(b) ('>=1 channel probeable on >=1 pool host'): satisfied via out-of-pool liveness hosts + bracketed local fixtures instead of pool-host channel probes, to preserve exposure-blindness (see VN-V9). Live drift disclosure: screening probe saw compr=213, frozen harness sees 168 (three consecutive identical runs); the admission gate, not the counts, is binding and is re-verified at EXECUTE.

target_pool.description: Frozen 4-seed pool, 2 engines, exposure-blind same-host path-prefix StaticLinks crawl (depth 6, budget 250/seed, 0.15s pace, Mozilla-compatible UA).

deep_confirmation_crawl_params.named_control: >=1 input/select/textarea with name or id (mdBook: mdbook-searchbar; Sphinx: name='q')

target_pool.note: All four seeds resolve to the declared host (no cross-host redirect). docs.readthedocs.io was excluded from the pool because /en/stable/ redirects cross-host to docs.readthedocs.com (seed-host-identity violation).

decision_rule_reachability.reason: Every decision outcome is arithmetically reachable on the frozen pool: E (#hosts with fraction>=0.50) ranges over {0,1,2,3,4}; SUPPORTS requires E>=2 with 2-engine span (meeting-host engine sets: with 2 mdBook + 2 Sphinx hosts, E>=3 always spans both engines, E==2 spans both iff one host is mdBook and one Sphinx); FALSIFIES at E==0; MIXED at E==1 or single-engine span; INCONCLUSIVE on empty denominators; MEASUREMENT_INVALID on gate/calibration/stability/hash failures. Branch-drive over the exact frozen code executed all 8 scenario branches with expected outcomes (all_branches_reachable=true).

measurement_prerequisites.reason: ADMISSION_GATE_V2 verified live at DESIGN (2026-10-11T04:03:55Z): total DEEP 418 >=10; hosts with >=3 DEEP: 4 >=2 (168/194/28/28); engines with >=3 DEEP: mdBook 362, Sphinx 56 (>=2). Parser/channel machinery proven on real non-pool hosts (sitemaps parsed: github.blog 1908, jetbrains.com 1611, wordpress.org 53, php.net 39 entries; RSS: jetbrains 211; JSON-LD: github.blog 14, wordpress.org 9, jetbrains 2) and on bracketed local fixtures (5/5, 0/5). Sample cap 40/host gives a 136-item episode budget; exclusion cap 10%/host.

baseline_identifiability.reason: Five baselines with stable ids: three replay procedures (B_LINK_FOLLOWING_BFS hop+1 GETs; B_PERSISTED_PATH_REACQUISITION RACQ_PATH requests/bytes; B_DIRECT_URL_REPLAY 1 GET/bytes) each with independent measurement, performed after the treatment phase on the same sampled items; plus two algebraic bounds (B_NO_DISCOVERY floor 0.0 = CAL_OPAQUE_FIXTURE; U_NO_BOUND ceiling 1.0 = CAL_DISCOVERABLE_FIXTURE). No baseline shares episodes with the treatment; each is identifiable from its definition alone.

control_sensitivity.reason: PC_DISCOVERY_CHANNEL_REACHABILITY passed on all three arms: (a) 5/5 out-of-pool liveness hosts returned parseable channel output through the frozen resolvers; (b) CAL_DISCOVERABLE_FIXTURE 5/5 on all 5 channels and CAL_OPAQUE_FIXTURE 0/5 on all 5 channels -> CALIBRATION_GATE True, so the machinery can both succeed and fail {1.0 vs 0.0 bracket}; (c) hop structure confirmed per seed (hop0 seed, hop1 samples, hop>=3 DEEP samples recorded). NC_SYNTHETIC_UNREACHABLE_ITEM: null_all_zero=true across 5 hosts x 5 channels. Controls are sensitive in both directions and would have failed loudly if the machinery were broken.

treatment_liveness.reason: The frozen treatment (five channel resolvers + measurement harness embedded in prereg.md section 13) is executable on the real substrate today: every resolver path executed successfully against real non-pool hosts (sitemap index/leaf resolution incl. nested chains, JSON-LD extraction, RSS/Atom parsing, searchindex parsing against fixtures for both mdBook JSON.parse and Sphinx Search.setIndex formats) and against local fixtures; all branch-drive scenarios ran end-to-end through the decision rule. No arm is structurally incapable of becoming EXECUTABLE. (Packet paragraph 53's Product-specific pre-freeze liveness requirement is formally Product-only; the analogous frontier evidence is provided anyway.)

freeze_artifacts_bound.reason: Interpretation depends only on (a) frozen spec.json/prereg.md text, (b) the complete executable embedded verbatim in prereg.md section 13 with sha256 480b8f4f26dbe06724fcebc831e61a811bd0d61dfcb91b43e4c58a97959debd2 (stdlib-only, reads no external files), and (c) live network state at EXECUTE (not a file). There is no mutable local code, task bank, dataset or fixture file whose identity could change the interpretation. EXECUTE must extract the code from section 13, re-verify the hash, and run it; any divergence is MEASUREMENT_INVALID. freeze_artifacts is therefore empty.
